closing confirmed by the customer, email AI that uses your connected tools, social listening, ask your centre, a save desk, desk activity, and a round of fixes.

Ticket close confirmation: before a ticket closes, the customer can be asked to confirm by email as well as by phone, with a follow-up call if they don't answer. A ticket with no answer closes by itself after the time you set. A customer who says it isn't fixed gets a new ticket linked to the old one, a supervisor who closes without confirmation gives a reason, and reports show how many closings were confirmed.

Email AI with connected tools: the email AI agent can use the tools of your connected MCP servers to look things up while it answers a ticket, and proposes any change on the ticket for an agent to approve once and run. MCP servers that sign in with OAuth can be connected, and signed in again when their access runs out. Disconnecting a server also takes its tools off every mailbox.

Social listening: posts that mention your brand on X and Instagram, and in news feeds, come into one list with their sentiment. A spike in mentions raises an alert, and a mention can be answered or turned into a ticket from the list. It is off until your plan includes it.

Ask your centre: on the centre summary and Reports pages, ask a question in plain words and get an answer worked out from your own reports, showing only what you are allowed to see.

Save desk: a customer who wants to cancel can be routed to a save queue, an agent can send a conversation to the save desk with one button, the centre check shows the save rate, and a ready-made save desk bundle sets it all up.

Desk activity: the agent desk can record how long each agent spends on each desk screen, active or idle, and the Desk activity report shows it. Record desk activity is off until you switch it on.

Desk tab recording: built, not yet available. It records the agent desk's own tab during conversations and plays the video from the call or chat page. It stays off for everyone until the agent notice has been approved.

Fixes: AI voice agents start speaking an answer from its first clause, so callers wait less, and no longer greet the caller a second time after the fixed first message; partner commission matches item rules to fee and seat lines, counts seats for per-seat rules and takes money in the currency's own units; a price list that can't be read falls back to the default currency; a double-click on Approve and run sends one request; the Meta guides match the setup steps; and the Academy has a What's new lesson for each release."}
